text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's summer! The beach! The sun! ☆ 
Spending it all together...?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Par-ty tiiime♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yay☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm filming right now. Don't talk over 
my video!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as the break started, Tosen Jordan 
was already on her smartphone, chatting 
with the gal Umamusume.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's resume practice in two 
hours.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't run away! Enjoy summer, will 
ya~? And while you're at it, you're on 
video duty, 'kay~?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then could you take a video with my 
phone too? I really want one with everyone 
in it!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The 1st Annual Watermelon Splitting 
Contest~☆ As for a stick... ain't got one. 
Guess you gotta smash it with your bare 
hands. Trainer can handle that much, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the floatie is all finished☆ Who 
wants to hop on?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right here☆ It's me! And you☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah♪ Everyone's got great smiles. I'll 
post this to the group chat~!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: 'Sup☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps their stamina is bottomless 
because they're Umamusume... Tosen Jordan 
and the others continued to enjoy the 
ocean at full power.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, wanna go grab some yakisoba soon? 
Let's eat some summer food!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Sounds great~!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, you too. Go on ahead. Go 
take a seat on a chair or something~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing my nails. Putting on cuticle 
oil. Since I went into the ocean, and I 
hate when they dry out.
choice_data_list:
Good job keeping up with your care 
routine.

You're doing great keeping up with your 
care routine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Duh, of course. Who do you think I 
am~?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Excuse meee, six yakisoba, please~.

text_block_list.name: Yakisoba Stall?
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Extra habanero and chili peppers— 
Super Spicy Diabolo Yakisoba it is!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh!? It's you~? Well, that 
explains why Golshi-chan let it slip~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(She is Gold Ship. Her relationship with 
Tosen Jordan is............)
choice_data_list: (…What kind of relationship do they have?)

(…I wonder what kind of relationship they 
have?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why are you the one making the 
yakisoba? And hey! Just normal yakisoba is 
totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, runnin' away?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not running away!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not running away!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp! T-T-T-That was close!! I almost 
got swept away!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I just wanna eat normal yakisoba!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch... You noticed, huh? Guess I've got no 
choice. I'll show it to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Here, toasted kamaboko-mayo power bowl.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: This isn't yakisoba, though?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, calm down. Just take a bite 
first.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Is it good?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, of course...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ring-a-ling☆ Ring-a-ling☆ 
Ring-a-ling-ling! Yes, Golshi Center 
here... Ah, valued customer! Thank you so 
much as always for your patronaaage~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, word just came in for my next 
delivery! Go ahead and eat without me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"So in the end, it's fine to eat the food 
sitting on that table, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside Tosen Jordan, I tentatively take 
a bite of the bowl's contents. As for the 
taste...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? When did you get ba— *gack*... 
*cough, cough*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it was surprisingly 
delicious. I feel like I'm welling up with 
energy, too."

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan, do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hell yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tosen Jordan managed to eat every last 
bite of Gold Ship's special yakisoba...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: S-Spicy... *hic*...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, well done, Jordan. That ice cream's 
your reward. Eat it later...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I-I... Ice... cream...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !? It's so swee—! Wait, what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time I've ever tasted 
something so delicious...!
choice_data_list:
Maybe it hits even harder after something 
spicy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ! What does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be Golshi-san's way of being 
nice? Saying ice cream tastes amazing 
after something spicy..."

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
!! That might be it! I mean, she did say 
it was a reward earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! Then Gold Ship, to treat us to the 
ultimate ice cream, went and...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you talking about? Ice cream 
tastes way better when you eat it 
normally.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?
